note: M5 lip sync (brief: "Audio-driven model via ComfyUI (pick the current best). Test on S43 first."): LatentSync 1.6 on the approved V take (scripts/l_batch.py), as Folks Like Us settled on 2026-10-20: it re-generates only the lower face of existing footage from the vocal, so the V take stays the take. It runs from ByteDance's repo in its own venv (~/LatentSync), not in ComfyUI, whose packages its pinned dependencies would replace; LTX-2.3's audio-video model kept a fixed mouth or moved the head there (Folks Like Us log/decisions.md). A 512 px crop that follows the face (YuNet, scripts/l_faces.py), 24 fps frames labelled 25 fps with the vocal sped up 25/24, pasted back through a feathered ellipse. Each take's "song_time" is its shot's span; the vocal and the master start at song time 0.
